title: CompTIA CySA+ CS0-003 Targeted Ultra-Violence Bank v1

questions.stem: EDR records a signed Microsoft process making an unusual outbound connection. Disk hash, parent process, and command line all appear normal. Which additional artifact would MOST strongly support that code was injected into the running process?

options.A: An executable private memory region containing code that is not backed by a loaded image
options.B: A loaded copy of winhttp.dll from the Windows system directory
options.C: A normal user token associated with the interactive session
options.D: A valid Authenticode signature on the on-disk executable

questions.target: 1.2 Endpoint analysis / hollowing versus legitimate execution
questions.stem: A process named updater.exe starts from its expected signed path. Memory analysis shows its original image sections are unmapped and the process entry point now lies inside a newly allocated executable region. Which interpretation is BEST supported?

options.A: The process is using a standard Windows update mechanism
options.B: The process was likely hollowed or otherwise had its executable image replaced in memory
options.C: The process loaded a legitimate unsigned plug-in
options.D: The executable was modified on disk after launch

questions.stem: An analyst suspects DLL injection into a long-running application. Which finding would provide the strongest corroboration?

options.A: The application has a child process created by explorer.exe
options.B: The process imports kernel32.dll and advapi32.dll
options.C: A DLL is mapped into the process from a user-writable path and was not part of the normal module baseline
options.D: The process has several established TCP connections

questions.stem: The SOC needs 60 days of evidence showing which internal hosts queried specific domains and which TLS server names they contacted. Payload retention is prohibited. Which source BEST fits?

options.A: Flow records containing source, destination, ports, and byte counts
options.B: Passive protocol metadata that records DNS transactions and TLS handshake fields
options.C: Only IDS alerts generated when signatures match known malicious traffic
options.D: Rolling packet capture retained for 24 hours

questions.target: 1.3 Network telemetry / flow versus protocol metadata
questions.stem: Investigators need to determine whether a host transferred unusually large volumes to a rare external IP over TCP/443, but they do not need domain names or payload content. Which telemetry is MOST efficient?

options.A: NetFlow or IPFIX records
options.B: Full packet capture
options.C: DNS resolver logs only
options.D: Endpoint file-integrity monitoring

questions.stem: A retrospective hunt asks which workstations contacted a newly identified malicious domain during the previous 30 days. The IDS had no signature for the domain at the time. Which retained data would be MOST useful?

options.A: Historical DNS query logs or passive DNS metadata
options.B: Only the IDS alert database
options.C: Switch CAM tables from the current day
options.D: Endpoint CPU utilization metrics

questions.stem: A message contains three Received headers. The corporate gateway added the newest header after accepting the message from an external relay. The external relay added the next older header claiming it received the message from payroll.example.com. Which statement is MOST defensible?

options.A: The payroll system is verified because it appears in the oldest Received header
options.B: The corporate gateway verifies only the external relay that directly connected to it
options.C: All Received headers are equally trustworthy because MTAs generate them automatically
options.D: The visible From header proves the external relay's older header is accurate

questions.target: 1.3 Email analysis / authentication versus header claims
questions.stem: SPF passes for bounce.vendor.example, DKIM passes with d=vendor.example, and the visible From domain is finance.corp.example. There is no organizational-domain alignment. DMARC for finance.corp.example is p=reject. What should a compliant receiver conclude?

options.A: Authentication succeeded because both SPF and DKIM passed
options.B: DMARC fails because neither authenticated identifier aligns with the visible From domain
options.C: DMARC passes because DKIM is cryptographically valid
options.D: The message should be accepted because SPF evaluated the envelope sender successfully

questions.target: 1.4 Threat hunting / direct telemetry for persistence
questions.stem: A hunt hypothesis is that attackers are creating new Windows services for persistence. Process creation and firewall logs are already retained. Which additional telemetry would test the hypothesis MOST directly?

options.A: Windows service-installation events and service-control-manager logs
options.B: DNS logs from internal resolvers
options.C: Proxy logs for outbound web browsing
options.D: NetFlow records from the data-center core

questions.stem: A scanner flags a Linux service based on an upstream version banner. The distribution vendor commonly backports security fixes without changing that upstream version string. What should the analyst do before accepting the finding?

options.A: Treat the banner as definitive evidence of vulnerability
options.B: Verify the installed package release against the vendor advisory and changelog
options.C: Close the finding because supported distributions are assumed secure
options.D: Increase scan intensity until the banner changes

questions.stem: A suspicious native executable must be examined without execution. The analyst needs to identify functions that reference credential APIs and determine likely call paths. Which approach BEST fits?

options.A: Static disassembly and decompilation with cross-reference analysis
options.B: Attach a debugger and set breakpoints on the credential APIs
options.C: Execute the sample in a sandbox with network access disabled
options.D: Run only strings and infer control flow from printable text

questions.stem: Most corporate laptops remain off VPN for long periods, but security needs authenticated patch and configuration checks whenever devices are online. Which design BEST meets the requirement?

options.A: Use endpoint vulnerability agents that report over the internet
options.B: Run a longer credentialed scan from the internal scanner each night
options.C: Scan each device's public IP from the internet
options.D: Rely on unauthenticated external scans for patch status

questions.stem: Two findings both have CVSS 9.8. One affects an internet-facing production API with active exploitation reported publicly. The other affects an isolated test host scheduled for decommissioning next week. Which action is BEST?

options.A: Treat both as equal priority because the base scores match
options.B: Prioritize the production API and document the environmental and threat context
options.C: Prioritize the test host because isolated systems receive less monitoring
options.D: Lower the production finding because public exploits are already understood

questions.stem: An application checks available credit in one database query and posts a charge in a second. Concurrent requests can all pass the first check and exceed the limit. Which fix MOST directly addresses the root cause?

options.A: Add input validation for the charge amount
options.B: Make the check and update atomic with appropriate transaction locking
options.C: Require reauthentication before each charge
options.D: Rate-limit each client to one request per second

questions.stem: A patched shared library is installed successfully, but a scanner still detects the old vulnerable version mapped into several long-running application processes. What should happen NEXT?

options.A: Restart the affected processes so they load the patched library, then rescan
options.B: Reinstall the package from a different mirror
options.C: Mark the finding false because the package database is current
options.D: Disable local vulnerability checks until the next maintenance cycle

questions.stem: Responders confirm two compromised hosts, an abused privileged account, and three active C2 destinations. The attacker is still accessing sensitive records. Which containment plan is BEST?

options.A: Block one C2 destination immediately and watch the rest
options.B: Stage isolation of the hosts, revoke the account, and block the C2 destinations in a coordinated action
options.C: Reimage the first host before changing account access
options.D: Delay containment until the full attacker objective is known

questions.target: 3.3 Lessons learned / root cause versus corrective action
questions.stem: A former contractor's remote-access account remained active for months and was later abused with valid credentials. Which statement BEST separates root cause from corrective action?

options.A: Root cause: valid credentials were used; corrective action: eliminate remote access
options.B: Root cause: failure to revoke access; corrective action: strengthen offboarding and periodic access review
options.C: Root cause: the VPN was internet-facing; corrective action: stop collecting VPN logs
options.D: Root cause: the attacker targeted a contractor; corrective action: prohibit contractors

questions.stem: EDR and mail telemetry show a malicious attachment executed shortly before compromise. No competing initial-access evidence is present, but a potentially relevant VPN log source is unavailable for the period. Which wording is BEST for the final report?

options.A: Phishing is confirmed as the initial vector
options.B: The initial vector cannot be assessed because one data source is missing
options.C: Phishing is the assessed initial vector with stated confidence and the telemetry limitation documented
options.D: VPN compromise is equally likely because those logs are unavailable

questions.stem: Median remediation time for critical findings drops from 24 days to 10 days, while the count of critical findings open longer than 90 days doubles. The median includes only findings closed during the month. What BEST explains the divergence?

options.A: The program is improving because the median is lower
options.B: Long-lived open findings are excluded from the closed-item median
options.C: The severity model is assigning too many findings as critical
options.D: The scan engine is taking longer to complete authenticated checks

questions.target: 4.2 Executive communication / confirmed versus unknown impact
questions.stem: Investigators confirm unauthorized access to 27 accounts. Evidence of data exfiltration is still being analyzed. Which statement is MOST appropriate for an executive update?

options.A: Twenty-seven accounts were compromised and data was exfiltrated
options.B: No data loss occurred because exfiltration has not been proven
options.C: Twenty-seven accounts show confirmed unauthorized access; possible data exfiltration remains under investigation
options.D: No impact statement should be issued until the investigation is complete
